sourceFile: 8. BRS-161014 Report TEST new Yoke adhesion  JIG improve 2023.08.22_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable data but the changed-factor grouping and baseline/test conditions are incorrectly inferred.
issues: Changed factor uses row numbers as conditions instead of jig improvement levels.
Normal baseline is explicit in tension data but marked not explicit.
1st and 2nd improvement contexts are mixed without clear round grouping.
Second visual cited rows are not shown in provided context.
Change domain overstates supplier/material beyond cited condition text.
requiredUserQuestions: Should 1st and 2nd jig improvements be one validation case with rounds or separate cases?
correctionPlan: Define factor as yoke adhesion jig cutting improvement: Normal, 1st cut 0.1 mm, 2nd total cut 0.3 mm.
Use sheet/test round and date as subgroup keys, not input row numbers.
Add cited content rows for both improvement methods and all visual result rows.
Separate visual NG over-glue and tension outcomes under the same jig-improvement factor.
Limit domains to jig/process condition unless supplier change is explicitly evaluated.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist for many values but are insufficient for final use until grouping and missing context citations are corrected.
